title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.16 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It rejects contradictory primal and dual linear certificates, carries exact replay conclusions in subject-, evidence-, method-, scope-, and authority-bound judgments, and rejects unknown domain-check keys. Its release builder records observed stages in a deterministic typed receipt, validates a semantic artifact-role roster instead of reconstructing success from shared pass labels or magic counts, and orders every artifact projection by UTF-8 filename bytes rather than host path semantics. These checks establish only their declared finite algebra, local execution, artifact identity, or workflow scope; they do not establish external scientific truth or deployment authority. Release assets are built from exact tagged Git objects, keylessly attested before publication, and redownloaded for byte comparison. The protocol component remains byte-identical to 0.3.0-alpha.13, and the live Custom GPT remains the separately observed alpha.10 interface; indexed Knowledge bytes are NON_ADMISSIBLE_UNHASHABLE. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
